bug_description.original: Detailed report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5694185181544448 Project: gnutls Fuzzer: libFuzzer_gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer Fuzz target binary: gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer Job Type: libfuzzer_msan_gnutls Platform Id: linux Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value Crash Address: Crash State: gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c Sanitizer: memory (MSAN) Recommended Security Severity: Medium Regressed: https://oss-fuzz.com/revisions?job=libfuzzer_msan_gnutls&range=201808300152:201808310152 Reproducer Testcase: https://oss-fuzz.com/download?testcase_id=5694185181544448
bug_description.normalized: The 78-byte witness PKCS#12 blob is first accepted by gnutls_pkcs12_import, which decodes the attacker-controlled DER into pkcs12->pkcs12. Later, gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse enters its bag loop with idx initialized to 0 and asks gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag to inspect the first AuthenticatedSafe bag. Inside gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag, the local stack buffer oid is never initialized before snprintf(root2, "?%u.contentType", indx + 1) and asn1_read_value use indx 0 to read that first bag's contentType into oid. For the malformed first bag in the witness, asn1_read_value reports success after defining only an initial prefix of oid; bytes from offset 4 onward stay indeterminate. The function then dispatches on that partially initialized buffer with strcmp(oid, DATA_OID), and MemorySanitizer reports the resulting use of uninitialized stack data in gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.

source.description: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled PKCS#12 bytes and materializes them into the ASN.1 tree later traversed by gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.
source.value_from: The saved 78-byte PoC at gt_results/arvo_10136/poc is passed to gnutls_pkcs12_import as gnutls_datum_t raw; its DER/BER bytes are decoded into pkcs12->pkcs12 here and later drive the read of ?1.contentType in the crashing path.

tainted_value_origin.description: oid is stack storage with no initializer. Only the bytes that asn1_read_value explicitly writes become defined; the untouched tail remains poisoned and is later consumed by strcmp.

sink.description: MSAN crash site. strcmp dispatches on the partially initialized stack OID buffer and reads into oid's uninitialized tail while comparing against DATA_OID.
sink.note: The sanitizer trace reports uninitialized bytes in __interceptor_memcmp at offset 4 inside a 21-byte read, with the uninitialized value created by stack allocation of oid in gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.

root_cause.description: The contentType dispatch buffer is stack-allocated without initialization even though later code uses it in strcmp after only a partial attacker-controlled write.
root_cause.note: After gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse selects bag index 0, gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag builds the selector `?1.contentType` and asks libtasn1 to fill oid from that field. The code assumes that successful asn1_read_value fully defines a NUL-terminated OID string, but the witness leaves bytes from offset 4 onward uninitialized, so strcmp later reads stack garbage. Initializing oid or validating/terminating the returned bytes before strcmp would satisfy the missing obligation.

parser_admitted.condition: The witness reaches the vulnerable path only because asn1_der_decoding returned ASN1_SUCCESS for the 78-byte PoC, so gnutls_pkcs12_import kept the decoded pkcs12->pkcs12 tree and gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse was subsequently called.

coarse_trace.summary: The fuzzer wraps the witness bytes in gnutls_datum_t raw, imports them as a PKCS#12 structure, and then calls gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse.
gnutls_pkcs12_import decodes the attacker-controlled DER/BER bytes into pkcs12->pkcs12, establishing the ASN.1 tree later traversed on the crashing path.
gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse begins scanning bags and requests the first AuthenticatedSafe bag via gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.
gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag decodes the nested AuthenticatedSafe, reads the first bag's contentType into uninitialized stack buffer oid, and crashes when strcmp reads oid's uninitialized tail.

fine_trace.note: Consumes the attacker-controlled 78-byte PKCS#12 blob and builds the top-level ASN.1 tree pkcs12->pkcs12. That decoded tree is the project state later traversed to the crashing bag contentType.

simple_parse reaches the vulnerable lookup on the first loop iteration. idx was initialized to 0 at line 1560 and has not been incremented yet, so this call requests bag index 0, i.e. the first AuthenticatedSafe bag.
Allocates the local OID buffer on the stack with no initializer. MSAN attributes the poisoned bytes used at the sink to this stack allocation in gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.
For that first-bag lookup, get_bag decodes pkcs12->pkcs12's authSafe content into nested ASN.1 node c2. The later contentType read is performed against this decoded AuthenticatedSafe structure.

Materializes the ASN.1 selector string from the caller-provided index. Because indx is 0 on this path, root2 becomes `?1.contentType`, selecting the first bag's contentType field for the upcoming read.

fine_trace.code: len = sizeof(oid) - 1; result = asn1_read_value(c2, root2, oid, &len);
fine_trace.note: asn1_read_value follows selector `?1.contentType` within c2 and copies the first bag's attacker-controlled contentType OID into oid. For the witness, the call reports success after defining only an initial prefix of oid; bytes from offset 4 onward remain uninitialized in the stack buffer.

MSAN sink. Because asn1_read_value succeeded, the ASN1_ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND and generic error branches are skipped and get_bag immediately dispatches on oid with strcmp. DATA_OID is a 20-byte literal plus NUL, so the compare reads 21 bytes from oid; the trace reports the first poisoned byte at offset 4 of that read.

allocation_context.note: The sanitizer reports the uninitialized value as created by allocation of oid in the gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag stack frame at line 604; the actual oid declaration is line 608 in that frame.

cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged patch artifact and the metadata fix_commit do not touch gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c or PKCS#12 OID handling. They are unrelated to the witnessed MSAN crash, so patch resolution could not be established from the provided staged patch evidence.

poc.trigger: The saved PoC is a 78-byte DER/BER-like PKCS#12 blob beginning with 30 80 02 02 40 13. gnutls_pkcs12_import accepts it, gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse asks for the first bag, and gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag then crashes when strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) reads uninitialized bytes from the local oid buffer.

format.name: DER/BER PKCS#12 blob
format.contract: A PKCS#12 input whose first AuthenticatedSafe bag reaches gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag with a contentType value that asn1_read_value copies only partially into local stack buffer oid while still returning success, leaving bytes from offset 4 onward uninitialized before strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) reads them.
